csv_project_name: DB for Perquimans Outpost Transit Facility
csv_scope_of_work: Albemarle Regional Health Services d/b/a Inter-County Public Transportation Authority (ICPTA), is issuing this Request for Qualifications (RFQ) to firms interested in performing professional Architectural and Engineering (A&E) Design Services and construction services for the ARHS-ICPTA Perquimans Outpost Facility, ICPTA is utilizing the Design-Build method of project delivery for the Perquimans County Outpost (Project), which will be constructed in Perquimans County, NC. A 3,600 square-foot, Operations Center 50% will include office space, break room, restrooms and amenities, 50% will be a shop for minor maintenance, washing, and supply storage. This facility will be equipped with a generator capable of operating the entire facility, transport sized propane fueling station for ICPTA vehicles, well-lit asphalt parking lot large enough to store 25 transit vehicles and secure fencing around all ICPTA vehicle storage areas. The entire facility will be equipped with HVAC.
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Design Build/Developer, Interior Design/Space Planning, Landscape Architecture, Programming, Civil Engineering, ITS Design, Transportation Planning

title: Design-Build for Perquimans Outpost Transit Facility
short_description: Design-build transit outpost with operations center, maintenance shop, fueling, and vehicle parking.
project_location: Perquimans County, North Carolina, USA; agency based in Elizabeth City, NC.
project_scope: New transit outpost facility in Perquimans County, NC using design-build delivery. The project includes a 3,600 sq ft operations center, with approximately 50% office space, break room, restrooms, and amenities, and approximately 50% shop space for minor maintenance, washing, and supply storage. Additional components include a generator sized to operate the entire facility, a transport-sized propane fueling station for transit vehicles, a well-lit asphalt parking lot for 25 transit vehicles, secure fencing around vehicle storage areas, and full HVAC for the facility.
services: Professional architectural and engineering design services and construction services under a design-build contract; requested disciplines include architecture, design-build/developer, interior design/space planning, landscape architecture, programming, civil engineering, ITS design, and transportation planning.
relevance_explanation:
- Small building project with limited structural ambition.
- Primarily a transit operations/support facility, not a bridge, stadium, long-span roof, or special structure.
- Scope includes architecture and civil engineering, but no notable structural complexity or innovative lightweight design is indicated.
- Includes design-build delivery, which can offer early entry, but the technical profile remains low for sbp.
- HVAC, parking, fueling, and site infrastructure dominate the program rather than demanding structural engineering.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction cost is stated in the tender text. Available scope for rough sizing: 3,600 sq ft building, maintenance/shop fit-out, full-building generator, propane fueling station, asphalt parking for 25 transit vehicles, fencing, lighting, and HVAC. This suggests a small to medium transit support facility, but a reliable USD estimate cannot be derived from the provided text alone.
fee_explanation: No fee information is stated. The notice is for a design-build procurement combining A&E design and construction, so any engineering fee would likely be embedded in the design-build price rather than separately identified.
contracting_authority: Inter County Public Transportation Authority (Albemarle Regional Health Services d/b/a ICPTA), Elizabeth City, North Carolina, USA. Contact: Cody Copeland. Phone: 252-338-4480.
